details:
What does it do & How does it work? Space Health Monito is a mission-control web application designed to track real-time astronaut biometrics and Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) data. It functions by continuously aggregating simulated or live telemetry streams, visualizing vital signs (heart rate, oxygen levels, fatigue metrics), and monitoring cabin life support parameters to detect anomalies instantly.

Benefits & Intended Impact The platform ensures crew health, safety, and operational efficiency during long-duration space missions. By providing early warning alerts and predictive health insights, it enables flight surgeons and astronauts to proactively mitigate medical risks before they escalate into critical emergencies in space.

Tools & Technologies Used

  • Frontend/Backend: Modern web stack (Vite, React/Next.js style architecture) hosted efficiently on Vercel (space-health-monito.vercel.app).
  • AI & Data Analysis: Integrated intelligence frameworks and data processing scripts to analyze biometric trends and ECLSS telemetry.
  • Development Toolchain: GitHub for version control, Google AI Studio, and Cloud Shell.

Creativity & Key Considerations Our approach blends intuitive astronaut-facing dashboards with robust mission-control monitoring. We prioritized low latency, clean UI/UX under high-stress simulated environments, data reliability, and actionable telemetry visualization tailored specifically for deep-space mission constraints.
